title: Cross-cohort heart-failure signature generalisation and the limits of pre-LVAD transcriptomic recovery prediction: analysis code
description:
Analysis code accompanying the manuscript Cross-cohort heart-failure signature generalisation and the limits of pre-LVAD transcriptomic recovery prediction: a leakage-controlled multi-cohort benchmark.

The pipeline integrates eight public human left-ventricular transcriptomic cohorts using DerSimonian–Laird random-effects meta-analysis of Hedges g, bootstrap L1-penalised logistic regression and gradient-boosted trees (XGBoost, TreeSHAP), with all feature selection confined to training cohorts under leave-one-cohort-out (LOCO) validation. Pre-LVAD myocardial recovery is modelled in the outcome-labelled pre-LVAD hearts of GSE328059 with in-fold sequencing-batch adjustment, repeated stratified cross-validation, full-pipeline label permutations and held-out-batch evaluation. Frozen models are tested once in an independent bulk pre-LVAD cohort (PRJNA1312133, quantified with Salmon) and transferred to single-nucleus pseudobulk profiles (GSE226314). Consensus-clustering subtyping and paired post-LVAD analyses are included. The stages are numbered 01–09 and run with run_all.sh.

Note: the code was re-implemented from the manuscript Methods with AI assistance; results are close to, but not identical to, the manuscript values (see VALIDATION.md). Raw data are not included and are available from GEO and the European Nucleotide Archive.
